# Real ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) known-answer-test vectors.
#
# D/Z/EK are the NIST ACVP keyGen KAT (gen-val/json-files/ML-KEM-keyGen-
# FIPS203/{prompt,expectedResults}.json, tgId=2, parameterSet="ML-KEM-768",
# tcId=26), fetched from github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server on 2026-09-09.
#
# DK, M, K, C were computed with `kyber-py` (a pure-Python FIPS 203
# ML-KEM implementation, https://pypi.org/project/kyber-py/), run against
# the same D/Z seed and a fixed 32-byte M, as an independent second
# reference (ACVP publishes keyGen and encaps/decaps as separate KAT
# groups keyed by internally-generated keys, not one seed carried
# end-to-end, so DK/M/K/C are not themselves NIST-published bytes -- but
# EK from this same D/Z round-trips byte-for-byte against the real NIST
# vector below, and kyber-py implements FIPS 203 directly from the spec
# text with no shared code with this crate, so agreement here is strong
# independent evidence of correctness for encaps/decaps too, not just
# self-consistency).
D=e582b7d75e6c80b05ae392a1fc9f7153b12390fd99930368cc67a768baebc8a0
